title: Prescribed Ideal Classes in Ennola Cubic Fields and Rational Points on Associated Elliptic Curves
summary: For every prime $\ell\geq5$ and integer $n\geq2$, we construct an Ennola cubic field with a specified prime ideal above $\ell$ whose class has exact order $2^n$. For parameters satisfying two square conditions and explicit congruences, the same squareclass obstructions give four independent rational points on the associated elliptic curves. A Pell equation describes all such parameters. A genus-one base change gives five independent sections that generate a subgroup saturated at two.
